__comment_IndexNow: Test key so E2E can verify the key file. Empty Endpoint: nothing is submitted.
__comment_AutomationTiming: Shortened so automation emails (e.g. MemberWelcome) reach the E2E specs fast. Production: CMSProcessContactActionsInterval 30 (appsettings.json), SchedulerOptions.SecondsInterval 30, EmailQueueOptions.LoadInterval 60000.
__comment_EmailMarketingOptions: Earlier than EmailMarketingOptions.CONSENT_GO_LIVE (the default) so E2E specs can seed a confirmation dated before the cutoff.
__comment_RateLimiting: Raised so the full E2E suite (many registrations/sign-ins from one IP) doesn't hit the limits. Production defaults: RateLimitingOptions.
